selected_script.angle: Absurd family uncle rescuer saves floor scratches and heavy lifting using adjustable low-profile moving dollies
selected_script.hook: Dragging heavy appliances is a nightmare for your floors and your back.

script_record.pain_point: Dirty floor corners under washing machines that are too heavy to move, scratching floors when dragged
script_record.conflict_hook: Adult nephew straining to pull a dryer while it scrapes the floor, then an uncle in neon ski gear enters with the dollies
script_record.product_solution: Adjustable low-profile dollies slide parallel under the appliance, lock with front brakes, and allow smooth rolling

timeline.scene: Close-up of a hand struggling to pull a washing machine, scraping the wooden floor, leaving a visible scratch.

timeline.purpose: 荒诞成年亲属携产品入场
timeline.scene: An uncle in a bright neon ski suit and snow goggles slides sideways into the frame, holding two silver metallic telescopic dollies, and says 'I got this, kid!'

He loosens the center joint fixing screw, pulls the metal frame horizontally to adjust length, tightens the screw, places the dollies parallel under each side, and presses down the front brake levers.
Washing machine rolls smoothly and effortlessly away, exposing the floor underneath for easy cleaning.
The dollies support a washing machine during its spin cycle, with anti-slip top pads reducing vibration and front brake levers firmly pressed down into locked position.
A heavy refrigerator on the silver stands rolls easily across a kitchen tile floor.
Text overlay: 'Your cozy spot starts here. Keep it clean and mobile.' with a neutral display of the dollies.

script_record.cta: Your cozy spot starts here. Keep it clean and mobile.
